subtitle.zh-CN: 黄色小恐龙 · 绿眼睛
subtitle.zh-TW: 黃色小恐龍 · 綠眼睛

description.zh-CN: 奶黄色的小恐龙，大大的脑袋、绿绿的眼睛，像小宝宝一样好奇天真，偶尔调皮。
description.zh-TW: 奶黃色的小恐龍，大大的腦袋、綠綠的眼睛，像小寶寶一樣好奇天真，偶爾調皮。
description.en: A butter-yellow baby dinosaur with a big head and green eyes. Curious and innocent like a toddler, and a little mischievous.

look: butter-yellow baby dinosaur, huge smooth gumdrop head flowing into the body with no neck, big round green eyes with black pupils set wide and low, small open "o" mouth, no eyebrows, chubby pear body, pale cream oval belly, stubby arms with tiny brown claws and pink palm pads, short legs with brown toenails, short thick tail
